subject: [PATCH v9 05/32] riscv: mm: add PMD swap-exclusive helpers

reviews.author: David Hildenbrand (Arm)
reviews.summary: Gave a Reviewed-by tag without any comments or concerns.

2026-11-05.patch_summary: This patch series adds PMD swap-exclusive helpers for RISC-V, allowing a PMD-mapped anonymous THP to be kept mapped across the swap round-trip. The new helpers wrap the existing PTE ones and reuse _PAGE_SWP_EXCLUSIVE.
